verdict.rationale: Secureframe has a dedicated ISO 27001 framework page that markets achieving and maintaining certification. Its supported frameworks come with control mapping and automated control testing that collects evidence, so ISO 27001 is a supported framework rather than a bare mapping. However, nothing in the evidence shows the specific first-class elements the story asks for. missing for 10: evidence of the current (2022) Annex A control set, Statement of Applicability generation/management, certification-audit artifacts (e.g., ISMS scope, internal audit, management review), and independent corroboration.
